evidence: Hooker Valley Track begins at White Horse Hill car park. It leads through the Hooker Valley to Hooker Lake, at the foot of Aoraki/Mount Cook.
White Horse Hill car park is at the end of Hooker Valley Road.
The track ends at Hooker Lake, where you’ll enjoy majestic views of Aoraki/Mount Cook and the Southern Alps/Kā Tiritiri o te Moana.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

The page's three swing bridges are not separately named on the map. White Horse Hill Campground is described as 'at the start' but not as the start.
